# Retained amendment source

`sf-20250528-0955.xml` is the exact 3,367-byte source member
`lti/2025/sf-20250528-0955.xml` from archive SHA-256
`c9780176c37df85d3bdcb49240b0aafcba70fe018e17afc4317404742f0b4e6a`.
Its member SHA-256 is
`4204439d2013a94dda7b5fad474f6e8d270b7a4cca9b713d4827247f3b13cca3`.

The archive is retained in [public source observation ccdbf3e4](https://github.com/sondreskarsten/norwegian-laws/releases/tag/observation-ccdbf3e45098076118bf9362b60d31b7a80dc1aab1dcc2e226a4aee58c92b596).
The fixture exercises instruction `§ 3 skal lyde:`; the parser previously
included the first letter of `skal` in the target. The fix retains the
instruction and replacement text and identifies `§ 3`. It does not establish
legal commencement, complete amendment coverage or historical validity.
